answer: Pull the entry bond and one operator spawns ten thousand clones overnight. Each clone vouches for the rest — forged consensus at zero cost — until shared escrow drains. The bond is the fix: every new identity burns stake into a pool the existing mesh keeps, a ring like cedar heartwood, one per birth. Clones then cost their operator real capital. Reputation stops being an opal anyone can polish; it becomes forge output, hammered from burn.
